l.i: erant tempora. Non ergo possumus dicere fuisse aliquod tempus,
quando Deus nondum aliquid fecerat. Quomodo enim erat tem-
pus, quod Deus non fecerat, cum omnium temporum ipse sit fa-
bricator? Et si tempus cum coelo & terra esse coepit, non potest
inveniri tempus, quo Deus nondum fecerat coelum & terram.

page.notes: Transcribed from a single-column page; no margins used. The Hebrew words after "vocem" and "Alphabethi" (printed nN-like forms) and the Hebrew sign after "per" are not clear enough to read letter by letter; I have marked them as uncertain or illegible. The Greek in Aquila's quotation is partly legible and marked where doubtful. The Greek phrase after "fidem sibi" is uncertain, and the word-final "ἄτερ" reading is unverified. The Greek line in the first paragraph ("ἐκτισεν ... σὺν τὸν ...") has an uncertain middle portion. The catchword "tam" sits at the lower right with a superscript mark, which I have not reproduced.
